clean_pcmu.note: baseline; G.711 mu-law, the North American PSTN default

clean_pcma.note: G.711 A-law, the European PSTN default

ptime10.note: finer frame grid should improve onset precision

loss_10pct_jitter_30ms.note: degraded; onset frame itself may be lost

noisy_channel.note: high channel noise stresses the onset threshold

bad_tx_pacing.note: deliberately mispaced sender; QC must reject every call

tts_soft_onset_60ms.note: realistic TTS ramp-in; quantifies onset-definition uncertainty

tts_soft_onset_150ms.note: slow ramp-in; upper bound on onset-definition uncertainty
